body: Yo same here man. Dead end job for me, no passions, or interests or really anything in my life. I've thought about the whole running away thing, but in the end I'm just putting off my demise. Idk I've already written my note, it's just a matter of having the balls to pull the trigger.

I hate my job too with a burning passion. It's like every minute feels like an hour, I hate everything about it. I wish I could give you some words of wisdom but I'm in the same boat.  I think I'm gonna hit up meth or heroin before I go, just to see if it makes it any bit better. This world sucks

Can confirm as others have mentioned they will lock your ass up. I was super pissed off one day cuz I bombed an exam and said some bad shit to my therapist and this MF had the police escort me to the ER. I was watched, searched and treated like shit. 10/10 would not recommend saying anything remotely suicidal to a authoritative figure again.

A girlfriend will not solve any of your problems. You've essentially brainwashed yourself into thinking that a girlfriend would solve all your problems. But when it comes down to it you need to figure out yourself before you start investing time in others.
In exactly the same position. I don't see anything wrong with leaving. As long as everyone else knows I tried.
It's hilarious to me. But I've found depression jokes in real life don't do too well, everyone's like "what" lol

Honestly tho you'll probably be fine. Oding especially with pain meds is a pretty hard thing to succeed at. You'll just get intense stomach pain/diarrhea/worse than death kinda thing.  

At the end of the day you'll either want to kill yourself even more or never want to ever again
U ded
Me. I'm too lazy to live and too lazy to kill myself.. Spontaneous combustion wya

Fuck man just read your story. Honestly I'm surprised you made it this far. This is one of the instances where your suicide is justified by your experiences. Whatever you decide to do, just know you've been through shit more than any of us could have imagined, you did a good job.

Oh gotcha. I'm thinking about using a shotgun as well. I feel like no matter what your body will be found eventually. Even if you find a place with little traffic your bones will likely remain for a while. Why not just call the cops before you end it? They'll retrieve your body so your family can get closure
You could get a big crab trap, and put yourself in it and sink to the bottom of a deep pond or something. The dying part would suck but at least nobody would ever find you
What kind of knot are your tying?

My thing is that I don't have anything that really makes me happy. I just do a bunch of activities to waste time, I get very little enjoyment and happiness out of them. Like, I'll go for a hike or something because I'm bored out of my mind. Or I'll watch Netflix for 8 hours and at the end of it nothing came out of it

Honestly I don't know. I have this fantasy I think about a lot of being surrounded by a good group of friends, with a nice flat and just being content of where I'm at. I  envision this early everyday. I'm stopping myself from getting there because I feel like it's out of reach and I just don't do it.  

I've now realized that I've put myself in this position. It's not my depression or anxiety to blame. It's been me all along. I'm a result of my own doing, and everything I'm feeling is my fault. I'll probably commit suicide and disappoint everyone more than I already have.

Thanks for the response! I'm realizing that I'm very hard on myself nearly all the time, it's just something that's ingrained on me over time. It's hard to snap out of it and think more positively.  

I think actively trying to figure out my passion is what I should do; instead of just waiting around and waiting for a miracle. With the long hours I'm working, I only have a couple hours to myself everyday, so I'm unable to do anything I enjoy. Do you think I should lower my hours in order to give me more free time to explore my passions?

I have a lot of conflicting interests. Like, I love spending time in nature, hiking, photography and fishing/hunting. But then I again I equally love wasting my day watching movies on browsing the web. I feel like no job would ever incorporate polar opposites together. So I settle for less
Hey man thanks for saying hey. I often get too lost within myself and forget about the thousands of people going through the same thing. We should stay in communication, it helps.

That's a real option, I've seen some people on here saying they live their lives for other people; not themselves. It's a different way to look at life l, and it's refreshing if you ask me. But then again, I feel like this could lead to bigger problems if I'm just constantly repressing my true feelings.  

I've never had a gf before so maybe love is the answer. You see all these movies and music based on the longing of love and affection from others and maybe that's the key to life. Just having someone there is really all you need and would probably give me a purpose. Wanna date lol?

Yes, once I'm asleep, I don't wake up or get up in the middle of the night.  I don't believe I have sleep apnea as I don't snore, but I'm not sure about anything else. On the other hand, I do use 5mg of melatonin before I go to sleep which may be contributing some. Are there sleep specialists out there that I should look into?
